summary: This room is BLUELINE's own dense neighborhood — the genAI comic-authoring pipeline (Adopt the Craft, GenAI Camera, ControlNet as Topology, Frame Designer, Animate the Background, Blocked Not Prompted) plus the Shop specialists it leans on (Blender, ComfyUI, Depth Anything, SAM, LaMa, RunPod GPU Backend) and a couple of adjacent Loudon Live threads (LDN RTM, OBS, Loudon's Toolkit). It has clearly been through a careful weave pass before: nearly every plausible cross-domain link I tried to force (Flocking↔ControlNet as Topology via "both mirror Kuramoto," Review Layer↔GenAI Camera's internal shootouts, LDN RTM↔Loudon's Toolkit) failed the swap-in fidelity test — generic, not specific — so I'm reporting those as null. The real yield here wasn't cross-domain synthesis; it was **unsung paths inside Frame Designer and Animate the Background**, two long, tool-heavy entries whose prose names specific Shop specialists that never made it into frontmatter — a wiring gap left over from when the detailed field notes and the N-layer generalization were written/folded in. Frame Designer's "Field notes — rich-first/stylize-last, on RunPod" section is literally about RunPod GPU Backend and never links it; it also names Shop/ComfyUI, Shop/Blender, assume multi-agent, and The Commons in body prose with no frontmatter link. Animate the Background's "What N-layer separation actually needs" section names Depth Anything and SAM as the specific tools that do/don't work for its Order and Segment steps, again unlinked. All five/seven of these are genuine, quote-anchored, and one (assume multi-agent) is a priority newcomer this weave wants inbound links for. The four true newcomers seated in this room (GenAI Camera, ControlNet as Topology, LDN RTM, OBS) turned out to already be well threaded to their roommates — no further wiring needed there.

typed_relations.rationale: Frame Designer's whole 'Field notes — rich-first/stylize-last, on RunPod' section runs the pipeline on a rented pod and documents a real cost-safety gotcha there, but never links RunPod GPU Backend in frontmatter (confirmed absent both directions in the room file).
typed_relations.evidence: "Follow-on that re-ordered render→composite→style and moved generation to a cloud GPU." / "Cost-safety gotcha that bit hard: RunPod's create can return HTTP 500 yet still create the pod — a naive retry-on-500 leaked 11 pods"

typed_relations.rationale: The render leg is explicitly routed through ComfyUI by name in body prose, but ComfyUI isn't in Frame Designer's frontmatter (confirmed absent both directions).
typed_relations.evidence: "Seam-B conditioned render (`render_shot`: OpenPose+depth → locked pen-flow via [[Shop/ComfyUI]])"

typed_relations.rationale: The staging leg's primary method is named-in-body as living on Blender; unlinked in frontmatter.
typed_relations.evidence: "Authored Blender blocking (`newstory_bench`, on [[Shop/Blender]]) | clean single / dynamic poses, exact camera"

typed_relations.rationale: assume multi-agent is a priority newcomer (reached_by 6). Frame Designer's own RunPod gotcha names it as the reason cleanup must be namespace-scoped — an already-bracketed body link with no frontmatter counterpart.
typed_relations.evidence: "never an account-wide `GET /pods → DELETE all`, which strangles other agents' pods ([[assume multi-agent]])"

typed_relations.rationale: Frame Designer names the specific fix as now living in The Commons's RunpodPodProvider, but the entry it names isn't a room member and isn't linked in frontmatter either direction.
typed_relations.evidence: "Fix (now in the Commons [[The Commons|RunpodPodProvider]]): recover the pod by name after any non-200, never retry-leak"

typed_relations.rationale: Depth Anything is named as the specific tool that solves the Order step for N-layer separation — a load-bearing, specific claim (fidelity test: swapping in SAM or LaMa here would be false, since the very next lines say those fail at Order). No frontmatter link either direction.
typed_relations.evidence: "Order — who occludes whom. **Depth Anything V2** wins on the drawing itself — recovers front-to-back order, hands back a clean figure silhouette for free, and depth-banding gives a free coarse 3-cel split."

typed_relations.rationale: SAM is discussed twice with a real verdict — it fails directly on line-art but works once the drawing is converted to a flat-cel domain — a specific, load-bearing technical relationship, not a generic mention. No frontmatter link either direction.
typed_relations.evidence: "Photo-SAM (mobile + ViT-B), GrabCut, and morphology all **fail** on line-art objects; the figure comes out best from a **keypoint** mask, not SAM." ... "both photoreal and flat-cel conversions make SAM segment cleanly where raw line-art gave garbage"
